about: Prince Rupert is a city on Kaien Island on British Columbia’s North Coast, on Chatham Sound near the mouth of the Skeena River. Rainforest harbour, a deep-sea container and cruise port, and a role as the end of the Yellowhead Highway and VIA Rail define the misty coastal community. About 13,000 people live in Prince Rupert.
seoSummary: North Coast B.C. harbour city on Kaien Island—deep-sea port, rainforest, and end of the Yellowhead Highway.
